source: activej-jsonrpc hardening vectors - this implementation's own codes and strictness decisions
stability: Vector NAMES are stable once published: features 03/04/06/07/08 reference them by name, so renaming or removing one breaks a downstream test. Adding vectors is safe.
note: envelope-too-large, batch-too-large and nesting-too-deep assume the DEFAULT JsonRpcLimits bounds (1mb / 100 / 64). A consumer that overrides a bound must skip or regenerate them.

vectors.name: envelope-too-large
vectors.description: an envelope beyond maxBodySize is -32001, refused on its length before any parsing. ASSUMES THE DEFAULT 1mb BOUND

vectors.name: batch-too-large
vectors.description: a batch beyond maxBatchSize is one -32002 document for the whole batch, not one error per excess element. ASSUMES THE DEFAULT BOUND OF 100

vectors.name: nesting-too-deep
vectors.description: nesting beyond maxJsonDepth is -32003, refused by a pre-parse scan because JsonReader.skip() recurses one frame per level. ASSUMES THE DEFAULT BOUND OF 64

vectors.name: invalid-response-both
vectors.description: a peer's Response carrying BOTH result and error violates 5 and is -32004, not our -32603; the id is still echoed

vectors.name: invalid-response-neither
vectors.description: a Response carrying NEITHER result nor error is equally invalid, and equally -32004

vectors.name: duplicate-member
vectors.description: a repeated defined member is -32600: neither occurrence is authoritative, so last-one-wins is refused rather than resolved

vectors.name: wrong-jsonrpc-version
vectors.description: jsonrpc must be exactly "2.0"; 1.0 is refused rather than tolerated, and the id is recovered

vectors.name: missing-jsonrpc-version
vectors.description: a version-less envelope is refused too, not treated as an implicit 2.0

vectors.name: fractional-id
vectors.description: a fractional id is not one of the three forms 4 allows; no id is recovered from a malformed id member

vectors.name: id-out-of-long-range
vectors.description: an integral id beyond 64-bit signed range is refused rather than truncated or widened

vectors.name: params-bare-literal
vectors.description: params must be an array or an object when present (4.2); a bare literal is -32600. result carries no such restriction

vectors.name: leading-bom
vectors.description: a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark is REJECTED as -32700, never silently stripped: stripping lets two implementations disagree about identical bytes

vectors.name: unknown-members-around-defined
vectors.description: unknown members before, between and after the defined ones are ignored and every defined member is still read - the skip(); continue; defect would drop them and change this answer

vectors.name: params-before-method
vectors.description: params preceding method decodes identically - the entire semantic justification for deferred payload decoding, since no codec for params exists until method is known

vectors.name: empty-method
vectors.description: an empty method name is refused exactly like a non-string one, as -32600; a strictness decision of this implementation
